topic: Remedial vs relaxation massage: which one do you need?

slides.headline: Remedial or relaxation massage?
slides.sub: How to choose the one that suits what your body needs.

slides.title: Relaxation massage: unwind
slides.body: Flowing, lighter strokes focused on helping you switch off. It's a nice way to ease general stress and tension, and you don't need a specific problem to book one.

slides.title: Remedial massage: a specific goal
slides.body: It starts with questions and a quick assessment. The therapist targets areas linked to your niggle, like a stiff neck from desk work or tight calves from running, using a range of techniques.

slides.title: It doesn't have to hurt
slides.body: Remedial can be firmer, but more pressure isn't always more helpful. Good remedial work stays at a level you can breathe through. Tell your therapist if it's too much at any point.

slides.title: Health fund rebates
slides.body: If your extras cover includes remedial massage, you can usually claim on the spot with HICAPS. Cover varies between funds and policies, so it's worth checking with your fund before you book.

slides.title: Massage plus movement
slides.body: Massage complements active rehab rather than replacing it. Many people feel looser after a session, and pairing it with simple stretches or strength work helps that feeling last longer.

slides.headline: Not sure which to book?
slides.body: Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physiotherapy can talk it through with you. Book online via the link in bio.

caption:
Remedial or relaxation massage? It depends on what you're after.

Relaxation massage uses lighter, flowing strokes to help you switch off. No specific problem needed. Remedial massage starts with a few questions and a quick assessment, then targets the areas linked to your niggle, like a desk-worker neck or runner's calves.

Remedial doesn't have to be painful, and more pressure isn't automatically more helpful. It also works alongside exercise, not instead of it.

If your extras cover includes remedial massage, you can usually claim on the spot with HICAPS. Check with your fund first.

Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physiotherapy are happy to help you choose. Book online via the link in bio.
